boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of New Hampshire
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations in Durham and nearby Dover with directly published late-hours information.

cards.title: The Blue Flame
cards.subtitle: 56 Main St, Durham
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s posted seasonal schedule before leaving; Thursday service is listed through 11 PM, with later Friday and Saturday closing times.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street restaurant with posted evening and weekend late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Flame lists summer hours until 11 PM Thursday, midnight Friday, and 1 AM Saturday.
cards.source_title: Late Night Breakfast Buffet at The Blue Flame Restaurant
cards.access_notes: Posted summer hours: Thu 7 PM–11 PM, Fri 7 PM–12 AM, Sat 7 PM–1 AM; the business says hours may change.

cards.title: Village Pizza
cards.subtitle: 45 Main St, Durham
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s hours page to plan an earlier evening pickup; it lists a 10 PM close Monday through Saturday and 9 PM Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza stop whose published hours reach 10 PM most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Village Pizza lists hours of 11 AM–10 PM Monday through Saturday and noon–9 PM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours run to 10 PM Monday–Saturday and 9 PM Sunday; confirm before traveling.

cards.title: Thai Smile 2
cards.subtitle: 13 Jenkins Court, Durham
cards.notes: Place a pickup order before the final seating window; the restaurant lists daily 9 PM closing, except Wednesday, and notes seating ends 30 minutes earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Jenkins Court restaurant with published 9 PM service on its open days.
cards.evidence_claim: Thai Smile 2 lists 11 AM–9 PM hours Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday; it is closed Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 11 AM–9 PM on open days; Wednesday is closed and last seating is 30 minutes before closing.

cards.title: Clark's American Bistro
cards.subtitle: 48 Main St, Durham
cards.notes: For a Main Street meal that runs into the evening, use the direct ordering page and arrive before its listed 9 PM close on Monday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street bistro with direct ordering hours through 9 PM most days.
cards.evidence_claim: Clark's American Bistro lists 11:30 AM–9 PM hours Monday through Saturday and an 8 PM close Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The direct ordering page lists Monday–Saturday service until 9 PM; Sunday service ends at 8 PM.

cards.title: Durham House of Pizza
cards.subtitle: 38 Main St, Durham
cards.notes: Plan for a pre-9 PM pickup: the restaurant lists 8 PM closing Monday through Thursday and 9 PM Friday and Saturday; it is closed Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street pizza restaurant with published evening hours at the end of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Durham House of Pizza lists 11 AM–8 PM Monday–Thursday and 11 AM–9 PM Friday–Saturday; Sunday is closed.
cards.access_notes: Published restaurant hours reach 9 PM Friday and Saturday; Sunday is closed.

cards.title: JP's Grille
cards.subtitle: 38 Main St, Durham
cards.notes: Use the direct ordering page for the current listed schedule; Friday and Saturday service runs to 9 PM, while Sunday and weekdays close earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Durham sandwich and grill counter with listed 9 PM weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: JP's Grille lists 11 AM–9 PM hours Friday and Saturday, 11 AM–8 PM Monday–Thursday, and noon–5 PM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Direct ordering hours show Friday–Saturday service until 9 PM; check the live ordering page for changes.

cards.title: Papa Jay's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 18 Broadway, Dover
cards.notes: For a later off-campus pickup or delivery option, check the pizzeria’s own page; it lists 11 PM closing every day, with different opening times.
cards.short_summary: A Dover pizzeria with posted daily closing at 11 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Jay's Pizzeria lists closing at 11 PM Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s hours table lists an 11 PM close daily; confirm delivery area and timing directly.

cards.title: OTTO Pizza Dover
cards.subtitle: 431 Central Ave, Dover
cards.notes: Use the location page for a later pizza plan in Dover; it lists the same 10 PM closing time every day and offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Dover pizza location with published 10 PM daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: OTTO Pizza Dover lists 11 AM–10 PM hours every day and states that dine-in, takeout, and delivery are available.
cards.access_notes: Published location hours are 11 AM–10 PM daily; confirm service mode and current timing before travel.

cards.title: Applebee's Grill + Bar Dover
cards.subtitle: 232 Indian Brook Dr, Dover
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, pickup, delivery, or carside pickup as appropriate; the official location page lists midnight closing most nights and 1 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Dover full-service restaurant with midnight-or-later published hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee's Dover lists 11 AM–midnight hours Sunday through Thursday and 11 AM–1 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location hours list midnight closing Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in and pickup are listed.

cards.title: Telly's Restaurant & Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 235 Calef Hwy, Epping
cards.notes: If traveling beyond Durham, check the restaurant’s kitchen schedule before departure; it lists 10 PM kitchen and dining closing Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An Epping restaurant and pizzeria with published 10 PM Friday–Saturday kitchen hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Telly's Restaurant & Pizzeria lists kitchen and dining hours until 10 PM Friday and Saturday and until 9 PM Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Published kitchen and dining hours reach 10 PM Friday–Saturday; Sunday–Thursday they end at 9 PM.
